content_sections.heading: OAV Bhakarsahi Balipatna Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Head Cook and 1 for Assistant Cook.

content_sections.heading: OAV Bhakarsahi Balipatna Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Head Cook: Male for Boys' hostel and Female for Girls' hostel. He/She has to stay in the hostel 24X7. If somebody is trained in cookery, he/she will be given preference & due weightage. Cook himself/herself be perfectly hygienic in his/her dresses, cooking habits etc. The committee staff conduct physical cooking of some items & evaluate the deliciousness/consumption of time preparation if the dishes/ hygienic condition of cooking & select the best. The cook must be well conversant to use LPG. Assistant Cook: Male for Boys' hostel and Female for Girls' hostel. He/She has to stay in the hostel 24X7. Having experience in cooking and other characteristics as specified above in 3. .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Bhakarsahi Balipatna Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.khordha.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Supporting Staff posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Supporting Staff posts is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Supporting Staff?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Supporting Staff, including 1 Head Cook and 1 Assistant Cook.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for these posts is a 10th pass.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Head Cook position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Head Cook position is between 30 to 40 years as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Assistant Cook position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Assistant Cook position is between 21 to 32 years as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Head Cook post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Head Cook post is Rs. 9000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Cook post is Rs. 6750/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through a practical cooking test, which carries 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website and sending it via registered post to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the application form and find more details?
faq.answer: The application form and detailed guidelines can be downloaded from the district website www.khordha.odisha.gov.in.
